doc: Lane brutality: the one-shot signature kills of the advanced weapons on humans (features/combat/kills). A row fires when a lethal hit from `weapon` lands on a human; style picks the kill (gib = the body blown into its rig parts). Speeds in m/s, spin in deg/s, timings in 60 Hz ticks. Under --gore=reduced no row dismembers: the victim falls with the standard death.

kills.doc: Rocket launcher: the body blown apart along the blast into its six rig parts (head with the hat, torso, both arms, both legs) that spin, bounce and slide, a red spray fan and ink splat, a scorch mark at the burst. n11 combat it32: hitstop_ticks 0 (was 4): the body leaves on the first tick, because the held parts stood the victim upright in his living pose inside the fireball for 4 ticks after the camera's kill hit-stop (wall time only), the hit-stop is the hold.

Hand cannon: the victim is blown off their feet in one piece, flies back along the shot, lands and slides on a long blood smear while the cap spins off; an exit spray fans out behind the body. No scorch. n16 kills-polish: the round leaves a drawn exit wound in the chest (torn cloth flaps, meat, rib arcs, the spine's knuckles; asset lane A6), wound_m wide, that tumbles with the body and dries on it (KillExitWound).

Fire (the flamethrower's long burst, and every fire death: molotov, fire patch, burning; gunplay's payload weapon `burn`): the victim, already running ablaze, stops as a charred ink silhouette with cream ember cracks, smokes where it stands, then crumbles into drifting ash flakes onto an ash heap over a soot scorch. No blood.

Electro gun: the bolt locks the victim in a stiff convulsion while an X-ray flash strobes his skeleton (weapon-art's sticker) inside cream arcs, then he drops stiff along the shot, scorched, smoke rising from the collar. No blood. Under --reduced-motion no strobe and no shake.

Ohm's forked bolt (lane ghost-powers, weapon ohm_bolt): the electro gun's X-ray kill done by the soul: the victim locks in the stiff convulsion while the skeleton strobes inside soul-teal arcs on a teal-white zap star (edge soul; the electro gun's are cream), then drops stiff, scorched, smoke from the collar. No blood. Under --reduced-motion no strobe and no shake.

Katana: one clean diagonal slash cuts the body in two along the blade's line (shoulder to hip). Both halves of the real rig slide apart off the cut on red smears, a raw red edge on each, the blood fanning out along the cut in the swing's direction; a cream slash streak marks the blade's path. Under --gore=reduced the victim falls whole. n16 kills-polish (owner n15 verdict): the slash streak is shorter and thinner (streak_m 1.0, streak_w_m 0.06; was 1.7 / 0.11), so it reads as the blade's path, not a white stick across the cop. n16 kills-polish: the cut line runs cut_up_m 0.8 m above the body's ground point, through the drawn torso (at 0 it passed through the feet: in the upright view one half held the whole standing figure). Each half then topples split_topple_deg 80 away from the other about its ground point (KillSplitHalves), so the cut man drops in two pieces instead of two upright pieces sliding apart.

Plasma rifle: the bolt burns a clean round hole through the torso (the street shows through it), its edge glowing hot cream inside an ink rim and cooling to a charred brown over 1.5 s; the victim drops back along the shot, cauterised: no blood. The bolt flies on (gunplay's projectile). n16 kills-polish: the hole sits hole_up_m 0.4 m above the body's centre (it was at the hips), and the wound smoke is a smaller ink-grey (the cream puffs washed the standing victim pale).

Plasma sword: the katana's diagonal cut with a hot blade: the two halves of the real rig slide apart, their cut edges cauterised (a hot cream band in a heat bloom, no red), no blood and no smears; the cream slash streak marks the blade. n16 kills-polish (owner n15 verdict): the slash streak is shorter and thinner (streak_m 1.0, streak_w_m 0.06; was 1.7 / 0.11), so it reads as the blade's path, not a white stick across the cop. n16 kills-polish: the cut line runs cut_up_m 0.8 m above the body's ground point, through the drawn torso (at 0 it passed through the feet: in the upright view one half held the whole standing figure). Each half then topples split_topple_deg 80 away from the other about its ground point (KillSplitHalves), so the cut man drops in two pieces instead of two upright pieces sliding apart. n16 kills-polish it4: the hot blade's path stays burned into the street, a scorch line scorch_line_m 1.4 m along the cut under the halves (soot band, ink core, no red): the bloodless kill's aftermath.

Chainsaw: the grind. The saw bites into the victim, who stays held on it shaking for most of a second while blood spurts back off the chain in a continuous spray and cream sparks fly off the teeth; then the body falls apart in two halves, cut straight along the saw's push, on red smears with a raw red edge. Under --gore=reduced the victim falls whole. n16 kills-polish: the cut line runs cut_up_m 0.8 m above the body's ground point, through the drawn torso (at 0 it passed through the feet: in the upright view one half held the whole standing figure). Each half then topples split_topple_deg 80 away from the other about its ground point (KillSplitHalves), so the cut man drops in two pieces instead of two upright pieces sliding apart. n16 kills-polish: through the grind the bite throws saw_chunks 8 drawn pieces (meat, bone chips, a rib, a tooth; KillSawChunks) out through the body, away from the saw; they land and lie on the street.

Ray gun: the victim locks up glowing, then dissolves in rings: the body is eaten from its outline inward by a hot cream ring while gold echo rings ripple out and glowing motes fall, leaving a heap of glowing dust drawn out along the ray with the empty uniform crumpled flat on it and the cap knocked half a metre off (hat_kick_mps). No blood. Under --gore=reduced the victim falls whole.

Homing shard gun: the shards stick in, the victim freezes on them for grind_ticks (the body held whole), then bursts into its six rig parts thrown forward along the shot (200 deg) in a full ring of red mist (spray 360 deg). No scorch.

Mini-nuke: everyone in the radius is vaporised where they stand, the body burnt into the street as a flat charcoal shadow that stays (the char print at 0.8 alpha, no embers, smoke or crumble), on a soot ring. No blood, no flash of its own: the shell's flash is gunplay's (under the screen-flash budget and --reduced-motion).

Tonnage's press slam (lane ghost-powers, weapon stomp: a kill inside ghost_attacks.json tonnage.crush_m): the victim is flattened where he stood, the whole body pressed wide and dark into the street (KillCrushFx) on a wide red splat, the cap squirting off to one side. No flight, no scorch: the press is cold steel.
Tonnage's ram (lane ghost-powers, weapon ram): the press body hits like a truck: the victim is thrown aside in one piece along the charge, tumbles, lands and slides on a smear, the cap spinning off.

Dent's overloaded car bomb (lane ghost-powers, weapon dent_blast): the rocket's gib, thrown out of the car's blast: the body blown into its six rig parts with a red spray fan, ink splat and a scorch mark. hitstop_ticks 0 like the rocket (n11 combat it32): no upright victim in the fireball.
Dent's seized car hits a human (lane ghost-powers, weapon dent_car): thrown off the bonnet in one piece along the car's nose, tumbling, landing on a smear, the cap spinning off.

Kerf's blink-slice (lane ghost-powers, weapon kerf_slice): the plasma sword's diagonal cut done by the soul's cutting beam as Kerf passes through: the two halves of the real rig part slowly off the line, the cut edges cauterised teal-white (a soul-teal bloom round a white-hot band, no red), no blood and no smears; the cream slash streak marks the beam. Under --gore=reduced the victim falls whole. n16 kills-polish: the cut line runs cut_up_m 0.8 m above the body's ground point, through the drawn torso (at 0 it passed through the feet: in the upright view one half held the whole standing figure). Each half then topples split_topple_deg 80 away from the other about its ground point (KillSplitHalves), so the cut man drops in two pieces instead of two upright pieces sliding apart.

Pistol (lane kills-new, n16; the most used gun, so short and clean). The patrol cop, riot cop, SWAT and suit ped play their own drawn cells (cells: KillDeathCells, 5 facings x 4 frames, faced toward the shooter): t0-8 the head thrown back, the exit spray and the cap/helmet flying off (from t8 the drawn loose cap or helmet, KillLooseArt, arcs 1.1 m back along the shot over 12 ticks, tumbling, and stays on the street); t8-14 the knees buckle, blood running from the head; t14-21 he pitches forward, arms limp; from t21 he lies face down, head toward Rivet, the back-of-head wound up (the corpse). KillSnapArt adds the red jet and mist out of the back of the head (t2-9). Any other kind: the head snaps back 22 deg (t0-2), hangs (t2-8), buckles (t8-14), then from t14 his own drawn fall grid (KillFallCells) plays over 18 ticks facing the shooter; a parts rig lays the body copy by the pose track (t14-26). Aftermath: the face-down body, the exit fan on the street behind where he stood.

Machine pistol (lane kills-new, n16): the stitch. Four rounds walk up the body from the hip to the neck, 3 ticks apart (t1-10): each one a red spurt out of his back along the shot (KillStitchArt) and a jerk of the figure (the pose track, alternating 6-9 deg, kept on the drawn frames: fx cells_lean). The patrol cop, riot cop, SWAT and suit ped play their own drawn cells (KillDeathCells, 5 facings x 5 frames, faced under the blow): t0 one wound at the hip, t4 two, t7 three up to the chest and the cap or helmet tipping off, t10-18 the spin (the drawn edge-on frame turned a full circle through his facings onto the fall side), from t18 on his side, curled, across the shot. Any other kind: the ink holes ride him, and his own drawn fall grid (KillFallCells) whirls from t10 and drops sideways across the shot (t18-32). Aftermath: the body across the shot, a narrow dotted spray along it.

Gloria, the nail gun (lane kills-new, n16): pinned. On the hit (gib hold 2) the nails streak in along the shot (KillPinArt); with a wall within 1.4 m behind him (the stage's push_out, probed along the shot) he is slammed back onto it over 6 ticks and hangs there by both sleeves, feet 0.12 m off the street, writhing (dying out over 80 ticks from t10); on the open street a nail through the boot holds him down. The patrol cop, riot cop, SWAT and suit ped play their own drawn cells (KillDeathCells, 5 facings x 3 frames, facing the shooter; KillPinArt.frame picks the frame, cells.at = pinned, writhe, on the street): on the wall frame 1 (pinned through both sleeves, arms out, head slumped, blood from the sleeves) and frame 2 (the knees jerked up) on the writhe's peaks, no lean (he is nailed); on the street frame 1 as the nails hit, then from t8 frame 3, on his back with both hands at the nailed boot and the cap or helmet beside him, rocking at half the writhe (fx cells_lean). The drawing carries the driven nails. Any other kind: the coded nail stubs stay with the body; on the wall his standing copy writhes 12 deg, on the street he falls back (his own drawn fall grid, t2-16), a nail through the foot and one through the far sleeve. Aftermath: the pinned body and the nails.

Gatling (lane kills-new, n16): the shred. No hit-stop (the stream never stops). t0-24 the stream holds him upright, shaken back hard every 1-2 ticks (the pose track: leans of 2-12 deg away from the gun), and every 3 ticks a torn scrap of cloth or flesh with a cream bone fleck leaves his figure (hip to neck) with a red spurt and flies up to 1.4 m along the stream to lie on the street (KillShredArt, 8 scraps). From t24 what is left drops: his own drawn fall grid (KillFallCells) over 12 ticks, falling back along the stream. (fx cells_at 0 + fall_at 24 = the buckle frame from the hit: no jump at the drop, but a jump and a hunched figure at the kill; rejected by film 13:05.) Aftermath: the body among the scattered scraps, a wide spray behind. Alternative (one data change): pieces = the six rig parts + grind_ticks 24 holds the parts and KillShredArt shakes them and drops them in a heap at his feet (wants kills-polish's drawn gib pieces, GibCardPieces.dress_rig, on a card victim). The patrol cop, riot cop, SWAT and suit ped play their own drawn cells (KillDeathCells, 5 facings x 3 frames, facing the shooter; the stream still shakes them at 0.6 of the track, fx cells_lean): t0 shaken back upright, arms flung, ragged red holes, spray leaving behind him; t12 sagging or kneeling, the shirt torn open over cream ribs, shoulder-bone knobs, the cap or helmet knocked off beside him; from t24 the heap on his back, ribs, a spine stub and a torn-off arm, turned to lie along the stream (fx cells_turn_from 2). Their scraps are the drawn ones (cells.scraps: cloth, a pocket, flesh, flesh with bone, a belt or strap piece, a sleeve end; scrap_cell_m 0.25 across), spinning as they fly.

Electro baton (lane kills-new, n16): the overload. Unlike the electro gun's X-ray strobe: no skeleton, no strobe, no arcs; the current cooks him from inside. Hit-stop 3 (the heavy blow). t3-45 he stands locked with a fine tremble (1.5 deg every tick; none under --reduced-motion) while cream veins of light spread from his chest into his limbs, brighter each tick, a cream glow builds under the skin, steam puffs rise off his collar and shoulders every 6 ticks, and his eyes burn as two cream points that go out at t40 (KillCookArt). From t45 his own drawn fall grid (KillFallCells) drops him back along the blow over 10 ticks, and smoke rises off the body for 200 ticks. No blood (spray 0, no blot). The patrol cop, riot cop, SWAT and suit ped play their own drawn cells (KillDeathCells, facing the shooter, 5 facings x 4 frames): t0 locked rigid, cream veins of light; t20 brighter, arcs and steam; t40 sagging, head lolling, smoke; from t45 on his back, smoking, in a grey soot ring, turned to lie along the blow (fx cells_turn_from 3). The drawing carries the glow, veins and eyes; the coded steam and smoke stay.

Molotov (lane kills-new, n16): the torch. The flamethrower keeps burn_char (he stops and chars where he stands, then crumbles); the molotov's spirit soaked into his clothes keeps burning ON him. The sim names every fire death `burn`; KillFireSource (view side, CombatArena.struck) names the fire weapon that last hit him, and a burn death with no fire hit on record walked into a ground fire, the molotov's. No hit-stop (the fire killed him, not a blow). t0-6 he drops to his knees mid-run (the pose track's squash), t6-16 he sags forward, from t16 his own drawn fall grid (KillFallCells) folds him face down along his run over 10 ticks; amber flame tongues with a cream core lick up his figure and then along the drawn body (KillTorchArt, 6 tongues, 0.5 m) until t180, shrinking from t120; then smoke rises off him for 200 ticks. No blood. The patrol cop, riot cop and SWAT play their own drawn cells (KillDeathCells, 5 facings x 4 frames, turned along the run by fx cells_turn_from 0): t0 on his knees, arms flailing, flames on the shoulders and back; t8 hunched, beating at the flames; t16 face down, burning along the back and legs; t150 the same pose charred to ink, smouldering, the bottle neck and glass beside him. On them the coded tongues flicker over the drawn flames once he lies (fx cells_flame_m 0.3 m; the drawing does not flicker); none over the drawn kneel (fx cells_kneel_flame_m, default 0: filmed at 64 px/m a tongue there read as a cream spike through him). The suit ped keeps the placeholder (his kneeling frames were refused by the image filter).

Rivet's charged bare claw (lane kills-new, n16; until now it borrowed the electro gun's X-ray shock through that row's also_weapons): the throw. The baton cooks him from inside and the electro gun strobes his skeleton; the claw is Rivet's own body, so it throws him. Hit-stop 4 (the full charge lands). t0-4 a cream arc jumps from the claw into his chest (KillThrowArt) and the pose track lifts him onto his toes, leaning back; t4-20 the discharge throws him back along the blow, lofted 0.4 m in a low hop, his standing figure tipped back up to 54 deg in the air (the track's tip), his own drawn fall grid (KillFallCells) shown from t14 with its rows stepping from t8 over 10 ticks (fx fall_at: it enters half fallen; from t8 it showed a hunched buckle mid-flight, from t14 with no fall_at an upright pop); he lands at t20 2.4 m out and skids on to 3 m by t32 (slide_m by the track's tip share). A cream spark crawls over him every 4 ticks to t60 (none under --reduced-motion), an ink skid line stays from where he landed to his boots, smoke rises off him for 160 ticks. No blood. Reads at 32 px/m as a body flung across the street. The patrol cop, riot cop, SWAT and suit ped play their own drawn cells (KillDeathCells, 5 facings x 4 frames, carried by the same slide and hop): t0 struck stiff with the bolt in his chest, t4 flung curled, t20 landed on his back, t40 still with smoke off three claw gouges, every frame facing the shooter, so he lies on his back with his head away from Rivet (filmed at 64 px/m: fx cells_turn_from 2 laid him head toward Rivet, which does not read as thrown back). Their drawn corpse hangs back off its anchor toward the shooter, so at slide_m 3 his boots landed 1 m from Rivet (filmed at 32 px/m, dir 0): own cells slide fx cells_slide_m 4.2 instead (KillDeathCells.slide_m_of). Kinds without cells keep the fall-grid placeholder.
